einzeiler: Live from New York, analyzing the midterms, crypto heists, and welcoming Hillary Clinton.
kurzfassung: Kara Swisher and Scott Galloway record live from the Beacon Theater in New York City with special guest Hillary Clinton to discuss the midterm elections and political futures. The hosts break down a massive crypto heist linked to North Korea, tech stock trends, and recent market developments. They also field questions from the audience, including a surprise appearance by Michael Barbaro.
stichpunkte: Hillary Clinton joins the show live on stage to discuss the upcoming midterms and potential 2028 Democratic contenders.
Clinton emphasizes linking the affordability crisis directly to government corruption.
Binance recovers 95% of the assets stolen in a record $6.3 billion hack confirmed by the FBI to be orchestrated by North Korea.
Apple posts strong earnings with revenue rising 12% following recent price hikes and iPhone 18 Pro demand.
OpenAI plans to rebrand its AI data centers as compute campuses amid anticipated regulatory scrutiny.
Scott Galloway presents historical data comparing job growth and GDP under Democratic versus Republican administrations.
Michael Barbaro from The Daily makes a guest appearance to ask a question and seek advice on live events.

clips.text: Statistical comparisons showing that job creation and GDP growth have historically been higher under Democratic presidents than Republican ones.

beschreibung:
Kara and Scott kick off Pivot Tour 2026 in New York City! Former Secretary of State (and Kara’s new “High Stakes” co-host) Hillary Clinton joins them to discuss the drama in Michigan’s Senate race, Democrats’ chances in Texas, and what the party needs to deliver if it wins Congress. Plus, the Binance crypto heist, Apple’s earnings, and OpenAI’s data center rebrand.
This episode was recorded live at the Beacon Theatre in New York City on November 2, 2026.
